newsitem.title: USA: Stocks end lower on profit-taking after last week's run.
newsitem.headline: Stocks end lower on profit-taking after last week's run.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average ended slightly lower Monday, hit by profit-taking as the market paused after racking up four record highs last week on good corporate earnings.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow closed 3.36 points lower at 6,090.87 after Friday's record high close of 6,094.23. In the broader market, declining issues led advances 13-9 on active volume of 418 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
